band.allStores: Platform administration — you can see every store

gate.signInBody: This address is the platform back office. Sign in with the account that administers esy.
gate.deniedTitle: This account is not an administrator
gate.deniedBody: Your account manages shops, not the platform. To manage your shop, use the back office.

pending: This screen is designed but its data is not connected yet.

ui.failedTitle: That request did not go through
ui.failedBody: Nothing is shown here — figures that may be out of date would read as current.

money.excludesRefunds: Revenue and fees exclude refunded and cancelled orders — a refund is not revenue. The order count is every order placed.

stores.title: Stores
stores.sub: Every store on the platform — live and suspended.
stores.loadFailed: Could not load the store list.
stores.emptyBody: The first store to register appears here.
stores.emptyQueryBody: Try the address, or part of the owner's email.

suspend.title: Suspend {{store}}
suspend.body: The storefront stops serving customers immediately and the owner sees this reason. Orders already placed are not touched.
suspend.reasonPlaceholder: Why this store is being suspended
suspend.reasonHint: The owner reads this and it stays on the record. Be specific.
suspend.reasonTooShort: Write at least {{n}} characters so the reason is usable.

detail.notFoundBody: Nothing on the platform answers to “{{sub}}”.
detail.membersSub: Accounts that can manage this store
detail.noMembers: Nobody can run this store yet. Give someone OWNER below.
detail.addMemberHint: The account must have signed in at least once — identities come from Google, so an address nobody has used yet cannot be given a role.
detail.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this store? They lose access to the back office; their shopping history is untouched.

billing.title: Billing
billing.sub: Service fees accrued by each store.
billing.emptyBody: Fees appear here as soon as a store takes its first paid order.

admins.title: Admins
admins.sub: Accounts that can open this host.
admins.loadFailed: Could not load the admin list.
admins.emptyBody: Nobody can open this host until an address is added — check ADMIN_EMAILS on the server.
admins.addHint: The account signs in with Google using this address. Access begins at their next sign-in — if they are signed in now, they must sign out first.
admins.duplicate: This address is already an administrator.
admins.envLocked: Granted by the app.admin-emails setting, not by this screen, so it can't be removed here. Change it in the configuration store, or in the ADMIN_EMAILS variable it falls back to.
admins.removeSelf: This is your own account — you will lose access to this host.

shell.sidebarNote: A separate host, separate routes, admin API only. Scopes are never mixed in one response.

config.title: Live configuration
config.sub: A change applies within seconds — no redeploy.
config.movedNote: This screen used to sit in the storefront, on a store URL. It moved here because a store contains no admin functions.
config.storeOfflineHint: The config store is unreachable, so values cannot be written right now. The figures below are the ones currently in effect.
config.blankDerives: leave blank to derive from the environment
config.reservedSub: Names no store can take. This list protects the platform’s own addresses — including manager and admin.
config.reservedEmpty: The server returned no reserved names.
config.reservedNote: Read-only. The list lives in the API so the storefront, the back office and this screen cannot disagree about it.

desc.serviceFeeRate: The platform’s cut of every order, as a fraction (0.02 = 2%).
desc.bogEnv: Which Bank of Georgia environment card payments run against.
desc.publicBaseUrl: The canonical public address used in links and redirects.
desc.bogAuthUrl: Bank of Georgia auth endpoint. Blank derives it from the environment.
desc.bogBaseUrl: Bank of Georgia API base. Blank derives it from the environment.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.sub: The channels the platform speaks through. Changes apply within seconds — no redeploy.
integrations.keyMissingHint: Without APP_SMS_KEY the one-time code is not sent by SMS — it is logged and returned to the browser so local work needs no messages. Set the key in the deployment before real sign-ups.
integrations.keyNote: Secret, held in the environment. Never shown here and not editable from this screen — rotating it is a deployment action.
integrations.senderNote: The name a recipient sees. Must be registered and approved with SMS Office. Max 11 characters; letters, digits, hyphen and period.
integrations.templatesSub: Every SMS the platform sends. Georgian is Unicode, so 70 characters is one billed unit and 71 is two.
integrations.requiredHint: {{token}} is required — without it the message cannot do its job.
integrations.langNote: Messages go out in Georgian. A shopper’s language lives in their browser, not on their account, so at send time there is nothing on the server that says which language they read — D12 makes Georgian the default.
integrations.cancelNote: A cancelled order is not texted. That is a conversation, often about money, and a one-line message is the wrong way to start it.
integrations.storeOffline: The config store is unreachable, so nothing on this screen can be saved. Current values are shown but every edit will fail until it is back.
integrations.disabledWarning: SMS is switched off. No message is sent — including the verification code, so nobody can finish checkout until this is back on.
